spec: docs/reports/WP12_PHASE4_METHODS_REVIEW.md section 5 (root-cause verification plan V1.1-V4.6) and section 6 (order of work); the user's 2026-10-31 supplement in docs/WP12_PLAN.md (Phase 4 numerical and physical root-cause verification first; a distance-threshold exceedance is never fracture evidence; no solver replacement; Phase 3 stays closed unless the physical state verifiably improves)
file_name_note: The methods review called this file configs/wp12/phase4_rootcause_protocol_v1.json; it is declared under the name the orchestrator assigned (phase4_verification_protocol_v1.json). Same role.
declared: 2026-10-31 (KST), WP-12 Phase 4. Written before any formal row of this verification ran. Only DEV smokes (label DEV, artifacts/wp12/phase4_verify_dev_001, capped control steps, never evidence) ran before the commit. The orchestrator commits this file; the formal runner refuses to run while it is uncommitted or modified. A change after the commit is a new protocol version. Failed or unstable rows are kept and reported, never rescored or silently rerun.
frozen_and_unchanged: src/robotic_cutting_sim/tlmpm_v5.py (sha256 recorded in every result.json), cutting law 8 and every law-4/5/8 parameter

tlmpm.py, tlmpm_v2.py, final_v4, every v1-v4 and goal threshold, WP-11 records, surface_protocol_v1/v2 thresholds, resolution_protocol_v1, phase4_e1_protocol_v1 and their run directories (artifacts/wp12/resolution_002, phase4_e1_001: read only)
the drivers scripts/run_wp12_resolution.py, scripts/run_wp12_phase4_e1.py and the Phase 3/1 probe geometry: imported read-only as private module instances; their files are not modified

labels.UNCHANGED_SOLVER: tlmpm_v5 + law 8 exactly; only the physics-neutral recorders are attached
labels.COUNTERFACTUAL_NOT_A_GATE: src/robotic_cutting_sim/tlmpm_v5_counterfactual.py (CounterfactualTLMPM, a subclass that replaces step() with a launch-for-launch copy plus opt-in hooks). Never tlmpm_v5.py, never selectable from any production preset, scene, LiveCuttingMaterial or policy path (tested). A COUNTERFACTUAL result tests a mechanism; it is never an acceptance result, never a law, never a profile, never an argument that a supported configuration passes
labels.READ_ONLY: host analysis of saved states of completed runs (no dynamics)
labels.STATIC: a final-state shadow relabel with no dynamics after it (V3.3); never a law or a simulation
labels.DEV: smoke runs before the commit; never evidence

rules: No verdict of this protocol changes law 8, the orientation envelope, any acceptance record or the Phase 3 decision. The only consequences are the ones the methods review section 6 lists (which prototype, if any, is worth building next)
A link-length or distance threshold only locates drift; it is never fracture evidence (user rule). Fracture is discussed only through the constitutive state (V2.2: psi, G_c)

Phase 3 (P5) is not re-measured here: surface extraction is off in every row (it would be measured on counterfactual states, which cannot reopen Phase 3; the review requires a supported configuration that passed full law-8 acceptance)

runner.physics: scripts/run_wp12_phase4_verification.py --row ID --device cuda:N --out artifacts/wp12/phase4_verify_NNN/ID (one row per process; refuses undeclared rows, an uncommitted/modified protocol for formal rows, and existing output directories)
runner.queue: scripts/run_wp12_phase4_verification_queue.py (rows in the declared order, lanes cuda:0 x2 + cuda:1 x2, never overwrites, GNU time logs in artifacts/wp12/logs/phase4_verify_NNN_<row>.log, queue.jsonl)
runner.read_only: scripts/summarize_wp12_phase4_verification.py (READ_ONLY rows V1.1, V2.1, V3.1, V3.3 STATIC, V4.1 and the verdicts; writes docs/evidence/wp12/phase4_verification_001.json)

setup.res: scripts/run_wp12_resolution.py run() exactly as configs/wp12/resolution_protocol_v1.json 'setup' declares (CUT, OBL20, TRIM, MULTI2 on the blade_master_flat_board_v1 geometry, ruler_knife_v2_y, kinematic ideal tracking, 20 ms control steps, CUDA graph per control step, cut_events_v1 on); variant 'formal'; surface extraction off
setup.e1: scripts/run_wp12_phase4_e1.py run() exactly as configs/wp12/phase4_e1_protocol_v1.json declares (CUT-01-R bar 160 x 30 x 20 mm on bar_flat_board = blade_master_flat_board_v1 Option A, LiveCuttingMaterial, cut_diagnostics_v1 + exit_candidates_v1 recorders); the row spec is given here (same fields as E1 rows); material dt other than 0.1 ms by replacing the driver's CouplingConfig(material_dt) only
setup.probe: blade_probe.drive_blade(ruler_knife_v1, law 8, tlmpm_v5, 1 mm / dx 4 mm / 0.1 ms, cutting_energy 5 J/m^2, legacy tray, CUDA graph, cut_events_v1) with the geometry and phases of run_wp12_phase3_surface.case_s7 (S7: 80 x 24 x 10 mm substrate + 4 mm dome r 9 mm, rho 25 deg skim 20 mm/s at 2 mm above the substrate, lift) and case_s1b (G3b: 80 x 30 x 12 mm block, vertical cut yawed 20 deg about z at 20 mm/s, lift)
setup.material: provisional, uncalibrated (resolution / E1: WP-11 cutting_tasks_v1 values E 50 kPa, nu 0.3, yield 1 kPa, rho 1500, mu 0.3, G_c 0.05 J/m^2, pic 0.05, k 0.1; probes: TLMPMConfig defaults with G_c 5 J/m^2)

recorders.flip_drift_v1: src/robotic_cutting_sim/root_cause_recorders.FlipDriftRecorder: after every step, drift_p += dt (v_p - sum_I w_pI v_I^MUSL), ugrid_p += dt sum_I w_pI v_I^MUSL (float64), first-assignment substep and position per digit. Physics-neutral: CPU bitwise test tests/test_root_cause_recorders.py
recorders.tool_contact_split_v1: root_cause_recorders.ToolContactSplitRecorder: before every step, recomputes the tlmpm_v5 blade contact (same functions) and accumulates the blade reaction split into armed in-zone and all other contacts, projected on the edge frame (advance d, edge e, normal n), counts, penetrations, released impulse. Reproduces the solver blade reaction (CPU test). Excludes handle, board and particle contact
recorders.tensile_energy_max_v1: root_cause_recorders.TensileEnergyRecorder: after every step, per-particle history maximum of the Hencky energy density of the trial elastic state (F Fpi after the J2 return of _stress): tensile part psi+ = mu |dev e|^2 + K/2 <tr e>_+^2 (Amor split) and total psi = mu |dev e|^2 + K/2 tr^2

counterfactual_options.position_update=grid_musl: x_prev <- x before the step; after _deformation and before the side assignment, x <- x_prev + dt sum_I w_pI v_I^MUSL (same field and slots as F); FLIP velocity v_p kept
counterfactual_options.pic: replaces config.pic (alpha of the G2P blend)
counterfactual_options.blade_contact_stiffness: replaces k of the blade contact in _rigid_contacts only (board/table fixtures, handle and particle-particle contact keep k = 0.1 / 0.05); refused with the legacy tray (shared k)
counterfactual_options.cutting_zone_m: replaces the cutting-zone half thickness |local z| <= zone (v5: the spacing s)

metrics.P1_bands: per non-conflicting lattice link |dx - Fbar dX| / s, P50 / P99 / max in bands of the reference midpoint distance to the declared cut locus: (0, 1], (1, 3], (3, 6], > 6 s. Locus: CUT x = 0; MULTI2 min over x = -12 / +12 mm; OBL20 the declared 20 deg plane through (0, 0, 9 mm); TRIM z = 18 mm; S7 z = 12 mm (edge path height); G3b the 20 deg yawed plane through (0.3, 0.2, 0) mm. FINAL state (and END_CUT* for res rows)
metrics.drift_identity: same-code links: explained fraction 1 - sum |r - (d_q - d_p)|^2 / sum |r|^2 per band (r = dx - Fbar dX, d = flip_drift_v1); residual P99; integrity: max |x - X - ugrid - drift| <= 1e-5 m
metrics.assignment_history: first band split into links whose endpoints got every digit at the same substep (or never) vs not
metrics.chip_links: TRIM (z_ref > 18 mm) and S7 (z_ref > 10 mm) non-conflicting links: long = |dx| > 2 s; fraction of long links with |Fbar dX| < 1.25 s; endpoint max principal stretch of F; det F P5; long-link fraction = long / links (a locator of drift, not fracture evidence)
metrics.chip_energy: final F, Fpi: Hencky energy after the J2 return of tlmpm_v5._stress, psi_dev (bound sigma_y^2 / 6 mu = 8.67 J/m^3), psi_vol = K/2 tr^2, psi_tensile (Amor split), von Mises, pressure, accumulated plastic strain; Griffith check psi+_max * t vs G_c = 0.05 J/m^2 (provisional) with psi+_max the tensile_energy_max_v1 history maximum and t the reference thickness of the chip in the particle's lattice column; the same number with the total energy (including compression, which does not drive a tensile tear) is reported, not gating
metrics.force: steady-window mean |F| of the solver's tool reaction (resolution driver contact_force.steady_mean_abs_N, the review's section 2.5 metric) and the tool_contact_split_v1 decomposition (window, steady)
metrics.p3_split: E1 rows: direct code-0 bridges and those needing a mis-sided label (P3b) vs in-core wedge (P3a) (root_cause_diagnostics.mis_sided_bridges); mis-sided labelled particles with s_ref and displacement at assignment (flip_drift_v1 assignment position)
metrics.topology: mechanical components, separation criterion, bridges, TRIM removal (drivers' own analysis)
metrics.dynamics: min det F, max speed, blade / board overlap, tool work, final momentum and kinetic energy

integrity: A row is COMPLETED only if finite (res: stability.finite; e1: E1 row_status PASS; probe: finite positions), split recorder overflow 0, exactly one solver instance, both recorders counted the same substeps, and the solver's own slot / cut_events checks did not raise. Anything else is FAIL_INTEGRITY or ERROR, kept, reported and excluded from the verdict of its hypothesis (which then reports the case as NOT_EVALUABLE).

verdict_rules.case: each case (one row or one row pair) is CONFIRMED / REFUTED / INCONCLUSIVE by the criteria of its hypothesis
verdict_rules.hypothesis: CONFIRMED iff every evaluable case is CONFIRMED; REFUTED iff every evaluable case is REFUTED; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (mixed or between the thresholds), always with the per-case list. NOT_RUN cases are listed and make the hypothesis INCONCLUSIVE when its refute criterion depends on them
verdict_rules.baselines: the unchanged-solver twin row of this protocol where one exists; otherwise the named resolution_002 / phase4_e1_001 row (unchanged solver, same physics; GPU atomic nondeterminism applies)

V1.1.label: READ_ONLY
V1.1.hypothesis: P1 is concentrated at cut faces and scales with dt and particles per cell
V1.1.inputs: every resolution_002 row (110), states FINAL and END_CUT*
V1.1.metric: first-band (<= 1 s) P99 / far-field (> 6 s) P99 per state; review section 2.1 values
V1.1.declared_values_note: [P50, P99] in units of s, FINAL state, first band; None = not declared; tolerance 0.005 / 0.02

V1.2.label: UNCHANGED_SOLVER
V1.2.hypothesis: P1 = integrated FLIP null-space drift (identity of review section 1.1)
V1.2.metric: drift_identity explained fraction e1 (first band), e4 (> 6 s); residual P99
V1.2.case_refute: e1 < 0.8 (then slot-history or light-node mechanisms dominate; measure them next)

V1.3.label: COUNTERFACTUAL_NOT_A_GATE
V1.3.hypothesis: the drift has a dt (1 - alpha)/alpha part and an alpha-independent part
V1.3.baselines: V12_*_dt0100 and B_S7_dt0100 (alpha 0.05, 0.1 ms); formal-alpha dt trend: V12_*_dt0050 and resolution_002 {CUT,TRIM,OBL20}_s100_g4s_dt0025
V1.3.metric: P1 first-band P99; chip_links; force; components; momentum / energy
V1.3.prediction: (a) alpha = 1: first-band P99 2-5x lower than alpha = 0.05 but not at the float floor (probe 1.88 -> 0.45 s): 0.2 <= r <= 0.5 with r = P99(alpha 1) / P99(alpha 0.05), and P99(alpha 1) > 0.05 s. (b) alpha per unit time fixed: the dt trend mostly disappears: |P99(0.1 ms) - P99_fixed(dt)| <= 0.5 |P99(0.1 ms) - P99_formal(dt)|
V1.3.case_confirm: (a) cases CUT/TRIM/OBL20/S7: 0.2 <= r <= 0.5 and P99 > 0.05 s; (b) cases (CUT/TRIM/OBL20 x 0.05/0.025 ms): the inequality holds
V1.3.case_refute: (a) r >= 0.8 (refutes the decomposition); (b) |P99(0.1) - P99_fixed| > |P99(0.1) - P99_formal| (the trend is not reduced at all)

V1.4.label: COUNTERFACTUAL_NOT_A_GATE
V1.4.hypothesis: positions advected with the F velocity remove P1
V1.4.baselines: 1 mm: V12_*_dt0100, B_S7_dt0100, B_G3b_dt0100; 0.5 mm: resolution_002 {CUT,TRIM,OBL20,MULTI2}_s050_g4s_dt0050 (READ_ONLY P1 bands)
V1.4.metric: P1 bands; assignment-history split; components, bridges, separation criterion, TRIM removal; force; blade and board overlap; min det F; momentum / energy
V1.4.prediction: first band >= 3x lower (probe P99 1.88 -> 0.38 s, P50 0.173 -> 0.059 s); same-history links at the float floor beyond 1 s; CUT/MULTI2 separation unchanged
V1.4.case_confirm: q50 >= 2 and q99 >= 2 (q = first-band baseline / counterfactual; the Phase 3 section 3.3 reopen measure) and no lost separation (components >= baseline's; separation_criterion true where the baseline's is true)
V1.4.reported_not_gating: q >= 3; same-history P99 beyond 1 s; TRIM removal; force; overlaps

V2.1.label: READ_ONLY
V2.1.inputs: resolution_002 TRIM rows (FINAL), artifacts/wp12/phase3_surface_001 S7_r0 / S7_r1 final states
V2.1.metric: chip_links: fraction f of long links (|dx| > 2 s) with |Fbar dX| < 1.25 s
V2.1.prediction: >= 95 % of long links are F-inconsistent (F stretch <= 1.11 in section 2.3)
V2.1.case_refute: f < 0.5 (a majority of long links is F-consistent; then the chip is really deformed and V2.2 decides)

V2.2.label: UNCHANGED_SOLVER
V2.2.hypothesis: no fracture criterion is reached in chips under the provisional material
V2.2.metric: chip_energy (history maximum of the tensile energy psi+)
V2.2.prediction: psi_dev <= 8.7 J/m^3 in chips (J2 bound), so a Griffith tear needs t >= G_c / psi ~ 6 mm in unconfined chips: no chip particle with t < 6 mm has psi+_max * t >= G_c
V2.2.gating_set: thin chip particles (reference column thickness t < 6 mm) that are NOT on a cut face (no lattice six-neighbour with a conflicting code). P2 is separation without codes; on a cut face law 8's codes already separate the material and the blade acts there. Cut-face particles are reported separately
V2.2.case_confirm: no particle of the gating set with psi+_max * t >= 0.05 J/m^2
V2.2.case_refute: any particle of the gating set with psi+_max * t >= 0.05 J/m^2 (then a fracture model becomes a physics question, review section 6 step 6)
V2.2.dev_disclosure: A DEV smoke of B_S7_dt0100 capped at 60 control steps (artifacts/wp12/phase4_verify_dev_001/B_S7_dt0100_c..e, not evidence) showed tensile-energy history peaks of 30-1700 J/m^3 on labelled particles within 1.5 s of the locus and 23-157 J/m^3 (psi+ t up to 0.63 J/m^2) on non-face particles 1.5 s from it: the review's psi_dev bound does not bound the dilatational part. The gating set and thresholds above were fixed after that smoke and before any formal row; they were not tuned to pass (the smoke already exceeds them)
V2.2.declared_choice: the tensile (Amor-split) energy is the crack-driving energy of the phase-field / CD-MPM models the review cites; compressive volumetric energy under the blade does not open a tear. Final-state psi and total-energy numbers are reported, not gating

V2.3.label: COUNTERFACTUAL_NOT_A_GATE
V2.3.hypothesis: the P1 fix removes chip scatter
V2.3.case_confirm: baseline / counterfactual long-link fraction >= 5 (or the counterfactual has 0 long links while the baseline has >= 5)
V2.3.case_refute: ratio < 2 (scatter stays; sub-cell chip motion needs its own study)

V3.1.label: READ_ONLY
V3.1.hypothesis: flat-board oblique bridges have two mechanisms (P3a in-core wedge, P3b mis-sided)
V3.1.inputs: all 47 phase4_e1_001 rows, resolution_002 OBL20 rows
V3.1.prediction: A_p10 and A_m10 96 / 96 P3b; A_p15, A_p20, A_p25, A_p35 (and mirrors) 0 P3b; A_p30 228 / 380; every OBL20 *_g4s_* row 0 P3b; OBL20_s075_g4mm_dt0100 450 / 650
V3.1.case_confirm: the declared counts reproduce exactly (deterministic read-only)
V3.1.declared_counts_note: [bridges, bridges needing a mis-sided label]; None = not declared

V3.2.label: UNCHANGED_SOLVER
V3.2.hypothesis: onset and P3a/P3b split depend on lattice phase
V3.2.baselines: phase4_e1_001 A_p10, A_p20, A_p30 (plane_x0 = 0: the plane contains the node line x = 0, z = 0)
V3.2.prediction: the onset moves with phase (some tilt in {10, 20, 30} deg that is CONNECTED at x0 = 0 changes outcome at some x0 in {0.5, 1, 2} mm) and / or the P3b share changes
V3.2.confirm: at some x0 an outcome differs from x0 = 0, or a P3b share differs from the x0 = 0 share at the same tilt by >= 0.25 (x0 = 0 shares: 10 deg 1.0, 20 deg 0.0, 30 deg 0.6)
V3.2.refute: every x0 gives the x0 = 0 outcome (CONNECTED) at all three tilts and every P3b share is within 0.25
V3.2.note: with tilts 10 / 20 / 30 deg only a change of outcome is observable; an onset below 10 deg or between the tilts is not resolved (single hypothesis-level case)

V3.3.label: STATIC
V3.3.hypothesis: a CRAMP-style visibility test separates swept wedges but not ligaments
V3.3.inputs: final states of every phase4_e1_001 row, the V3.2 E1b rows and resolution_002 OBL20 rows (h = 0)
V3.3.metric: root_cause_diagnostics.visibility_relabel (all-pairs rule): predicted components and bridges, labels, labels below the edge stop
V3.3.prediction: separates A_+-15/20/25/35 deg; stays CONNECTED at A_p10, A_m10, A_p30 (P3b); R rows with h >= 0.75 mm stay CONNECTED; <= 300 labels per row
V3.3.refute: any R row with h >= 0.75 mm or any N-control separates under the relabel, or > 1000 labels in a row
V3.3.not_run: the per-substep shadow evaluator exit_candidates_v2 and the review's negative controls N1-N9 (no such scenarios exist yet); the hypothesis therefore cannot be CONFIRMED in this protocol: at best INCONCLUSIVE (STATIC part consistent), REFUTED if a refute criterion triggers on the available rows

V3.4.label: UNCHANGED_SOLVER + COUNTERFACTUAL_NOT_A_GATE
V3.4.hypothesis: P3b is caused by displacement ahead of the edge (contact compliance, P1)
V3.4.metric: p3_split: P3b bridges, mis-sided labels, their s_ref and displacement at assignment; components
V3.4.classification: per variant (0.05 ms, k 0.4, grid_musl): VANISHES (0 P3b bridges), REDUCED (< 0.5 x the baseline count), PERSISTS (>= 0.5 x). P3b is a law-input problem if it PERSISTS under both k 0.4 and grid_musl
V3.4.verdict: no prediction: reported as INCONCLUSIVE (NO_PREDICTION) with the measured class

V4.1.label: READ_ONLY
V4.1.hypothesis: the dt dependence of force is series penalty compliance K_p = k m / dt^2
V4.1.metric: two-point fit F(dt) = F_inf / (1 + (dt / dt0)^2) on 0.05 and 0.025 ms; check at 0.1 / 0.2 ms
V4.1.prediction: CUT dt0 0.050 ms, F_inf 0.065 N; OBL20 dt0 0.069 ms, F_inf 0.091 N
V4.1.case_confirm: dt0 and F_inf within 5 % of the declared values
V4.1.reported_not_gating: MULTI2 fit; fit check at 0.1 / 0.2 ms

V4.2.label: COUNTERFACTUAL_NOT_A_GATE
V4.2.hypothesis: the same K_p gives the same force at any dt
V4.2.metric: steady-window mean |F| (solver reaction); out-of-zone overlap; momentum
V4.2.case_confirm: within 10 % (cases CUT and OBL20 at k 0.2 and 0.4)
V4.2.case_refute: off by > 25 % (another dt effect: alpha per substep, work integration)
V4.2.reported_not_gating: TRIM (no prediction); the dashpot k m / dt differs by 2x (zeta = sqrt(k)/2: 0.32 vs 0.16); comparison also against V12_*_dt0050

V4.3.label: COUNTERFACTUAL_NOT_A_GATE
V4.3.hypothesis: fixed physical stiffness makes force dt-invariant
V4.3.prediction: CUT 0.0145 N, OBL20 0.0275 N (the 0.1 ms values)

V4.4.label: UNCHANGED_SOLVER
V4.4.hypothesis: the frozen formula is pre-asymptotic, not divergent
V4.4.case_confirm: CUT in [0.055, 0.065] N, OBL20 in [0.080, 0.091] N (F_inf of V4.1 as the upper bound)

V4.5.label: UNCHANGED_SOLVER + COUNTERFACTUAL_NOT_A_GATE
V4.5.hypothesis: the coarse-spacing force collapse is the cutting zone |z| <= s
V4.5.metric: tool_contact_split_v1 steady-window decomposition (in-zone / out-of-zone, d / e / n)
V4.5.prediction: for s >= 1.36 mm every flank contact is in the zone (blade half thickness 0.75 mm + 0.45 s <= s) and carries no advance force
V4.5.case_confirm: unchanged rows at s = 1.5 and 2 mm: out-of-zone steady mean |reaction| <= 10 % of the total steady blade |F| of V12_CUT_dt0050 (s = 1 mm, same dt)
V4.5.case_refute: out-of-zone contacts at s = 1.5 or 2 mm carry more than that
V4.5.reported_not_gating: COUNTERFACTUAL zone = 1 mm: steady force at s = 1.5 / 2 mm vs the unchanged rows (expected >= 10x higher); zone = 1 mm at s = 1 mm equals V12_CUT_dt0050 by value (sanity, GPU nondeterminism); s = 0.75 mm decomposition

V4.6.label: UNCHANGED_SOLVER
V4.6.hypothesis: TRIM force has a second dt mechanism
V4.6.metric: tool_contact_split_v1 decomposition across dt; alpha-per-time rows from V1.3
V4.6.prediction: TRIM does not fit V4.1 (resolution_002 successive ratios 1.50 / 1.16 / 1.32)
V4.6.case_confirm: the declared ratios reproduce from resolution_002 within 0.02 (READ_ONLY) and the V4.1-style fit is off by > 25 % at 0.1 ms
V4.6.attribution: reported (zone / direction shares vs dt; alpha-per-time effect); no prediction

budget.estimate_basis: measured single-process walls of resolution_002 / phase4_e1_001 rows (recorders add < 5 %); estimated_wall_s per row
budget.cap_rule: sum of single-process walls of started rows; the queue starts no new row once the cap is reached and the remaining rows are NOT_RUN. Part A rows run first. The review's ~5 GPU-h covers part A (V1.2-V1.4, V4.2-V4.4); part B (V3.2, V3.4, V4.5, V4.6) is the review's 'with the completed E1' block
budget.devices: cuda:0 and cuda:1, at most 2 concurrent rows per device (other users' processes are never stopped)

V4.2: the k = 0.2 prediction comes from the V4.1 fit (no unchanged twin at dt = 0.0707 ms exists)
P5 (Phase 3 surface) is not re-measured (see rules)
